name: Rideout Customs
summary: Leonida's premier automotive performance and body tuning shop franchise, taking over the role of Los Santos Customs for custom lowriders, muscle cars, and superbikes.
description: Rideout Customs is the primary automotive workshop brand across Vice City and neighboring counties. In addition to high-end engine performance upgrades, turbocharging, and protective armor plating, Rideout specializes in coastal aesthetics: vibrant pearlescent neon paints, hydraulic kits, custom chrome rims, and tinted security glass.

seo.title: Rideout Customs: GTA VI Vehicle Modification Shops
seo.description: Complete guide to Rideout Customs garages in GTA VI. Workshop locations, tuning options, paint finishes, armor plating, and upgrade mechanics.
